name: gitguardian-ai
description: GitGuardian AI — GitHub monitoring & AI code review SaaS

scripts.dev: node --env-file=../../.env ../../node_modules/.bin/concurrently -n api,web,worker -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:worker"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @gitguardian/db && npm run build -w @gitguardian/api && npm run build -w @gitguardian/worker && npm run build -w @gitguardian/web
